acceptance: Every tuned/untuned number quoted in ADRs links to a committed or published result bundle and has a matching template_evidence.yaml entry, or is removed.
context: Found 2026-10-13 by an adversarial review of ClickHouse/DuckDB tuning at origin/develop 77048bfb9.
description:
## Problem
- The ADR-003 addendum quotes ClickHouse tuned/untuned numbers, yet `benchbox/core/tuning/profiles/template_evidence.yaml` has `measurements: []` for every template, and runs are labelled "unmeasured", which contradicts the ADR.
- No raw result files backing the numbers are in the repository.
- The measurements are SF1 on a single 16 GB host.

## Change
- Commit or link the result bundles behind each quoted number.
- Fill the registry entries (state, scale, memory, engine version, date, evidence link).
- Either qualify the ADR claims to what the evidence supports, or remove them.
